headline: Banco Macro Launches Private Banking Division in Argentina
summary: Banco Macro has launched Macro Private Bank targeting high-net-worth clients, expanding its financial service portfolio in Argentina.
why: Banco Macro is Argentina's largest private commercial bank by branch distribution, with ADRs trading on the NYSE.

impacts.name: Banco Macro
impacts.why: Establishing dedicated private banking services opens access to higher-margin wealth management revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
